scope: Production-generated recruits, first eligible founder per seed with required groups; no stat or star selection. Saved natural gains and legal purchases, XP explicitly granted for level checkpoints. Identical spending ceilings (400/600/800), actual spend and reserves recorded; kit prices differ. Two fixed supporting allies and three authored opponents per encounter; flat open field, two seeds, both sides. Double Grip off/on paired with identical current AI on identical starting units and seed. This is a controlled sample, not proof of universal build balance or natural campaign pacing.
baseline_verification: All 648 Double-Grip-disabled rows exactly reproduce the shipped 0.21 current-AI results; all 54 generated profiles are unchanged.
